﻿# Domain Review Board

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../README.md) • [Governance](../README.md) • [Governing Bodies](./README.md)**

> Gate 2 governing body providing specialized domain-specific review and validation covering security and AI/ML requirements through adaptive composition.

page_texts.2:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#governing-body-overview]

## Governing Body Overview

**Purpose**: Specialized domain-specific reviews and validation covering security and AI/ML requirements based on project characteristics.

**Charter**: The Domain Review Board (DRB) provides flexible, domain-specific governance through adaptive composition based on project needs. The DRB consolidates security and AI/ML reviews into a single efficient gate while maintaining specialized expertise and thorough evaluation. The Architecture Review Board (ARB) Input Template, Security Domain Input Addendum and AI Domain Input Addendum will be utilized as the input artifacts for the Domain Review.

**Body Type**: Decision-Making (has formal authority to approve, reject, or mandate changes)

**Gate Authority**: Gate 2 - Domain Review Process in the 6-gate governance framework

**GainwellNow Enterprise Architecture Governance**: [Submit ARB Request](https://gainwellnow.service-now.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=3d2faedac356ce908978decf050131f6)

[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#adaptive-composition-model]

## Adaptive Composition Model

The DRB composition adapts based on project requirements and trigger criteria:
page_texts.4:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#security-domain-review-mandatory]

### Security Domain Review (Mandatory)

**When**: Every project or standards-mandated request requiring ARB (Gate 3) submission — not conditioned on specific risk factors (e.g., PHI/PII data, external-facing applications, regulatory compliance requirements) or on whether the request follows the project-based or standards-mandated intake path, though those factors inform the depth of review
**Composition**:

| Role                | Representative                     | Responsibilities                          | Participation |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| **Chair**           | Chief Information Security Officer | Security oversight, compliance validation | Required      |
| **Security Arch**   | Security Architect                 | Security architecture, threat modeling    | Required      |
| **Compliance**      | Compliance Officer                 | Regulatory compliance, audit requirements | Required      |
| **Risk Management** | Risk Manager                       | Risk assessment, mitigation strategies    | As Needed     |
| **Privacy**         | Privacy Officer                    | Privacy compliance, data protection       | As Needed     |
page_texts.5:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#ai-domain-review-conditional]

### AI Domain Review (Conditional)

**When**: AI/ML solutions, automated decision-making, data analytics with AI, generative AI usage
**Composition**:

| Role                   | Representative        | Responsibilities                            | Participation |
| ---------------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| **Chair**              | Chief Data Officer    | AI governance, data strategy alignment      | Required      |
| **AI Ethics**          | AI Ethics Officer     | Ethical AI principles, bias detection       | Required      |
| **Data Science**       | Senior Data Scientist | Model validation, technical feasibility     | Required      |
| **Legal & Compliance** | Legal Counsel         | AI legal requirements, liability assessment | As Needed     |
| **Security Arch**      | Security Architect    | AI security, model protection               | As Needed     |

---
page_texts.6:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#meeting-structure]

## Meeting Structure

**Meeting Frequency**:

- **Regular Reviews**: Weekly for ongoing domain-specific project reviews
- **Expedited Reviews**: Ad-hoc for high-priority initiatives

**Duration**: 1 hour for single-domain focus
**Documentation**: Domain-specific decision records and compliance validation

---
page_texts.8:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#required-information]

### Required Information

- **Domain Assessment**: Specific security and AI/ML requirements and compliance needs
- **Risk Analysis**: Domain-specific risk identification and assessment
- **Technical Requirements**: Detailed technical specifications for domain validation
- **Compliance Matrix**: Security and AI/ML policy compliance requirements
page_texts.9:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#decision-criteria]

### Decision Criteria

- **Domain Compliance**: Adherence to security and AI/ML standards and requirements
- **Risk Mitigation**: Adequate risk identification and mitigation strategies
- **Technical Feasibility**: Domain-specific technical validation and approval

---
page_texts.11:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#primary-activities]

### Primary Activities

- **Domain Validation**: Review projects for security and AI/ML requirements and compliance
- **Risk Assessment**: Evaluate domain-specific risks and mitigation strategies
- **Compliance Verification**: Validate adherence to security and AI/ML policy requirements
- **Technical Review**: Assess technical approaches for domain-specific concerns
- **Standards Enforcement**: Ensure compliance with security and AI/ML standards and patterns
page_texts.12:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#key-deliverables]

### Key Deliverables

- **Domain Approval**: Formal approval for security and AI/ML requirements
- **Compliance Certification**: Documentation of security and AI/ML compliance validation
- **Risk Mitigation Plans**: Domain-specific risk management strategies
- **Technical Validation**: Domain-specific technical architecture approval
page_texts.13:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#review-scope]

### Review Scope

The DRB evaluates projects for:
page_texts.14:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#security-requirements-mandatory]

#### Security Requirements (Mandatory)

- Security architecture and threat models
- Compliance validation (HIPAA, SOC 2, etc.)
- Access controls and authentication
- Data protection and privacy
- Security testing and validation
- Industry-specific regulatory requirements
- Audit and compliance frameworks
- Policy adherence validation
- Documentation and reporting requirements
- Compliance monitoring and maintenance
page_texts.15:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#aiml-governance-conditional]

#### AI/ML Governance (Conditional)

- Ethical AI principles and bias detection
- Model validation and performance
- AI transparency and explainability
- Data governance for AI/ML
- Responsible AI implementation

---
page_texts.17:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#gateway-flow]

### Gateway Flow

- **Input**: Approved concepts from Gate 1 (Concept Review Board)
- **Process**: Security and AI/ML validation, compliance verification, risk assessment
- **Output**: Domain-approved projects proceed to Gate 3 (Architecture Review Board)
- **Feedback Loop**: Projects requiring remediation return with updated security and AI/ML requirements
page_texts.18:
[governance/governing-bodies/domain-review-board.md#exit-criteria]

### Exit Criteria

Projects approved by DRB must demonstrate:

- Complete security and AI/ML compliance validation
- Adequate risk mitigation strategies
- Technical feasibility for security and AI/ML requirements
- AI/ML governance compliance (if applicable): responsible AI use validated, risk classification completed, AI Oversight Committee approval obtained where required
